scripts.start:bg: nohup node dist/index.js > logs/daemon.log 2>&1 & echo $! > .daemon.pid && echo "aidevflow daemon started (PID: $(cat .daemon.pid))"
scripts.stop: node -e 'const fs=require("fs"); const file=fs.existsSync(".aidevflow.lock") ? ".aidevflow.lock" : (fs.existsSync(".daemon.pid") ? ".daemon.pid" : null); if(!file){console.log("aidevflow is NOT running");process.exit(0);} try { const data=fs.readFileSync(file,"utf8"); const pid=file.endsWith(".lock")?JSON.parse(data).pid:parseInt(data.trim(),10); process.kill(pid,"SIGTERM"); console.log(`aidevflow daemon (PID: ${pid}) stopped`); } catch(e){ console.log("Process was not running or already stopped"); } try{fs.unlinkSync(".daemon.pid");}catch(e){} try{fs.unlinkSync(".aidevflow.lock");}catch(e){}'
scripts.status: node -e 'const fs=require("fs"); const file=fs.existsSync(".aidevflow.lock") ? ".aidevflow.lock" : (fs.existsSync(".daemon.pid") ? ".daemon.pid" : null); if(!file){console.log("aidevflow daemon is NOT running");process.exit(0);} try { const data=fs.readFileSync(file,"utf8"); const pid=file.endsWith(".lock")?JSON.parse(data).pid:parseInt(data.trim(),10); process.kill(pid,0); console.log(`aidevflow daemon is RUNNING (PID: ${pid})`); } catch(e){ console.log("aidevflow daemon is NOT running (stale lock/pid file)"); }'
